ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Signal and Image Analysis. Prerequisites: IIntegral and differential calculus; introductory probability or statistics course; some familiarity with linear algebra; graduate standing in biological, physical, social, engineering or computer sciences.An introduction to signal analysis and processing methods for advanced undergraduates or graduate students in the biological, physical, and social, engineering and computer sciences. The course will develop an understanding of signal analysis methods and their capabilities, weaknesses, and artifacts with an emphasis on their practical application. Significant hands-on processing and interpretation of real data will be performed using Matlab. Students may not receive credit for both ECE 310 and ECE 498MH. "Credit in this course can not be used to satisfy requirements for an ECE graduate degree."
